title: Add Bub to Agentic Development
author: PsiACE
summary:
Adds [Bub](https://github.com/bubbuild/bub), a tiny agent runtime composable with plugins, to **Agentic Development** in the **Agentic AI Momentum Watchlist**.

Bub is Apache-2.0 licensed and has 1,700+ GitHub stars.
